reported.title: Lock never engages on a debounced request press
reported.description: The debounce logic at lines 53-67 only commits a new stableReq when the raw level has been unchanged for DEBOUNCE_MS, but reqEdge is reset on every raw change (lines 53-57) and the engage check at line 62 requires stableReq == LOW. Because the press is only sampled after the level has already settled, the transition into LOW is never latched as a fresh stable edge in time, so the engage branch is never reached. Measured evidence confirms this: "D9 missed 15 of 15 trigger(s): D9 never went HIGH within 200 ms of the trigger at 802 ms" and "D9 missed 4 of 4 trigger(s)" for clean presses and bounce. D9 missed 15 of 15 trigger(s): D9 never went HIGH within 200 ms of the trigger at 802 ms.

truth.description: Lock latches forever after first engage

truth_for_judge.description: Lock latches forever after first engage

exposing_checks.behaviour: D9 must follow its stimulus; LOW when D3 == 1; within 200 ms (Unlocked when door open)

judge_input.spec:
- Request button on D2 (pull-up); door-closed sense on D3 (pull-up, closed = LOW); lock solenoid on D9.
- Lock D9 engages (HIGH) when request D2 is pressed while door D3 is closed (LOW).
- Unlock (D9 LOW) when the door opens (D3 HIGH); unlock within 200 ms of door open.
- Debounce the request contact with 35 ms of stability before engaging.
- Print `vault lock=<0|1> engages=<n>` every 1000 ms.
- Do not re-engage while already locked; wait for a new request after unlock.
